**What was wrong:** `slugify` in `src/slug.js` lowercased the title and replaced every non-`[a-z0-9]` run with a dash, so accented characters like `è` and `û` were dropped and replaced with separators (`Crème Brûlée` → `cr-me-br-l-e`).

**Fix:** Normalize to NFD and strip combining diacritical marks (`\u0300`–`\u036f`) before slugging, so accented letters decompose to their base letters:

```js
return title
  .normalize("NFD")
  .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
  .toLowerCase()
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
```
